content.text: In one or two sentences, explain what Rust programming language is and why memory safety matters.

choice.text: Rust is a modern systems programming language that guarantees memory and thread safety without a garbage collector by using an ownership, borrowing, and lifetime system to enable high-performance, concurrent code. Memory safety matters because it prevents crashes, data corruption, and security vulnerabilities (like buffer overflows and use-after-free), making software more reliable and secure.
